contract_refs: strictGroupSize parameter contract: when true, each group should contain exactly groupSize results
contract_grounding.note: REST v2 search API contract defines strictGroupSize as a boolean to enforce exact groupSize per group. API violates this by returning more than groupSize per group when strictGroupSize=true

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 search → groupParams parsing (handler_v2.go) → internal search execution → grouping logic → strictGroupSize NOT ENFORCED → results exceed groupSize
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: strictGroupSize参数在分组逻辑中未被强制执行。虽然参数被解析,但结果截断逻辑未应用strictGroupSize约束。这导致即使strictGroupSize=true,分组仍可超过groupSize限制。这是真缺陷。

verdicts.rationale: REST v2 entities/search with groupParams.strictGroupSize=true does not enforce groupSize limit per group. Contract defines strictGroupSize as enforcing exact groupSize per group, but API returns 3 results per group when groupSize=2. Source code shows strictGroupSize is parsed but not enforced in grouping logic (missing truncation check). Matches REST v2 parameter handling bug pattern. Reproducible: search with strictGroupSize=true, groupSize=2 → groups contain 3 results each, violating constraint.
